note: Conceptual/architecture case-study lesson (the Meridian Parts incident) synthesizing Chapters 1-2's controls -- OAuth flow choice, Named Credentials, secrets rotation, guest user profile scoping, IP restriction, inbound signature verification, ownership, and monitoring -- into one realistic, illustrative incident narrative. Meridian Parts is a fictional composite scenario built from this course's own prior lessons, explicitly in the style of this catalog's existing case-study lessons (e.g. the data-security-privacy-and-classification course's Brightfield Retail case study), not a real company or reported breach, so no vendor doc citation applies to the narrative itself. The underlying technical claims it depends on (Site URL discoverability, guest user profile risk, signature verification need) were established and sourced in Lessons 6 and 10.
